changelog: - Redesigned App Drawer — Improved the App Drawer layout and visual appearance.
- Home Screen Improvements — Enhanced the Home Screen layout and customization experience.
- Soft Glass Clock — Introduced a new Soft Glass Clock design with a modern glass-inspired appearance.
- Adjustable Clock — Users can now adjust the clock size on the Home Screen.
- Resizable Search Bar — Added the ability to adjust the Search Bar height.
- Settings Improvements — Improved the Settings interface and customization options.
- Improved visual consistency across the launcher.
